# Waterloo HVAC Pros

> Waterloo HVAC Pros is a local HVAC company serving Waterloo, Waterloo Region, Ontario, offering furnace repair, AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump repair and installation, fireplace installation, thermostat repair, and duct cleaning to homeowners across the region.

Service areas: Waterloo, Cambridge, Kitchener, Elmira, Listowel, New Hamburg, Baden, Breslau
